psychological_meaning: Granny Smith Apple green evokes feelings of freshness, optimism, and health. It is associated with nature, growth, and renewal, promoting a sense of well-being and balance. This color can also represent abundance and prosperity, while its slightly tart association keeps it from being overly sentimental.
